CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Summer-2013 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Summer-2013 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 976 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 12 benchmark sites in 1 regions spanning 1 states (survey period: December 2012 to December 2012). These surveys captured 30 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 3 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 730 cards across 16 sites, with 0.3% showing evidence of mouse activity (2 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 54 transects across 14 sites (survey period: December 2012 to December 2012), detecting active burrows in 1.9% of transects (total: 1 active burrows).
